cover_prompt: Full-color illustration, warm romantic Parisian aesthetic, premium quality. A charming kawaii cat wearing a beret sitting at a tiny round bistro table on a cobblestone sidewalk in Paris. The table has a croissant on a plate, a steaming cup of cafe au lait, and a small vase with a single rose. Behind the cat, a classic Parisian cafe facade with a striped awning reading 'Cafe de Paris' and large windows with flower boxes. The Eiffel Tower rises softly in the background against a pastel sunset sky. Strings of warm fairy lights drape across the scene. Potted lavender and climbing roses frame the foreground. Soft warm color palette with dusty pinks, creamy whites, sage greens, warm golds, and soft lilac tones. Rich detailed cozy Parisian atmosphere. NO text, NO words, NO letters, NO title on the image.
